data: Which training set results in the highest accuracy when the ratio of external knowledge is 1?

The caption states that more external knowledge corresponds to higher accuracies. The question asks for the training set with the highest accuracy when the ratio of external knowledge is 1. From the figure, we can see that the line representing the 100% training set has the highest accuracy among all the lines at the ratio of external knowledge equal to 1. Therefore, the 100% training set results in the highest accuracy when the ratio of external knowledge is 1.
